Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) NON-COMPREHENSIVE AMC FOR PHOTOCOPIER MA CHINES

1. Scope of Work: The contractor shall provide Non-Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) services for Toshiba, HP and Duplo photocopier/printing machines installed at the Buyer’s premises. 2. Nature of AMC: The AMC shall cover preventive maintenance, routine servicing, inspection, troublesh ooting, and breakdown maintenance of the machines. 3. Spare Parts and Consumables :The cost of spare parts, toner, ink, paper, drum units, developer, and other consumables shall not be included in the AMC charges. Such items shall be supplied or replaced sep arately, subject to the Buyer’s approval and applicable procurement procedures. 4. Breakdown Maintenance :The contractor shall attend to breakdown complaints reported by the Buye r and carry out the necessary inspection and repair work. The cost of spare parts, if required, shall be quot ed separately and shall be borne by the Buyer only after approval. 5. Preventive Maintenance: The contractor shall undertake preventive maintenance at regular intervals to ensure the proper functioning of the machines and minimise breakdowns. 6. Complaint Response :Time The contractor shall respond to maintenance complaints within one worki ng day of receiving the complaint and arrange for a service visit as required. 7. Qualified Service Personnel :The contractor shall deploy qualified and experienced service engineer s capable of servicing the respective Toshiba, HP and Duplo machines. 8. Service Reports :The contractor shall maintain records of all maintenance visits, complaints attended, repairs carried out, and parts recommended for replacement. A service report shall be submitted to the au thorised representative of the Buyer after each visit. 9. Machine Details: The AMC shall cover only the machines listed in the GeM bid, specifying their make, model, serial number, quantity, and installation location.(Various Locations) 10. Contract Period :The AMC shall remain valid for the period specified in the GeM contract, commenci ng from the date stipulated therein. 11. Payment Terms :Payment shall be made in accordance with the applicable GeM contract conditions, subject to satisfactory performance of the AMC services and submission of the required invoice and suppor ting documents. 12. Contractor’s Responsibility :The contractor shall ensure timely maintenance and proper coordinati on with the Buyer’s authorised representative. Any repair or replacement involving additional expenditure shall require prior approval from the Buyer. 13. Confidentiality and Security The contractor and its service personnel shall maintain the confidentia lity of official documents and information accessible during maintenance activities. No document or data s hall be copied, photographed, transferred, or disclosed without the Buyer’s authorisation. 14. The Engineer Should have Fluent in English & Hindi. 15. The Bidder should have Local office in Coimbatore. 16. The Bidder has to Ensure that the Service provider are exactly as per the scope of the Work after Awar ding of the Bid. 17. Compliance with Technical Evaluation Matrix which is uploaded in Bid Specific ATC. . 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
